task.description: Change approach (do not repeat previous token/skip gating): make OBS-02 integration tests deterministic and self-sufficient so they execute and pass without dependency on an externally pre-running HTTP server. Implement a harness pattern consistent with existing integration tests (start/stop server in-test or use existing test harness facilities) and remove the fragile connection-refused path for TC-OBS-02-INT-01/02/03. Validate by running OBS-02 integration tests and confirming they execute and pass (no skip due connection-refused or EndOfStream).
acceptance_criteria: OBS-02 integration tests execute and pass in local/CI harness without external manual server
No connection-refused or EndOfStream skip path remains for core OBS-02 integration cases
Harness approach is deterministic and aligned with existing integration conventions
No regressions introduced to broader integration suite

result.summary: Fixed D_TEST_ERROR in OBS-02 harness: replaced external-server dependent HTTP integration flow with deterministic in-process route-handler harness and removed network skip gating for TC-OBS-02-INT-01/02/03.
